COMMAND.name: snmp-server community
COMMAND.help: SNMPv2c community (rw is served as read-only)

PARAM.name: name
PARAM.help: Community name (4-32 chars, no spaces, quotes, @ , # or \)

COMMAND.name: no snmp-server community
COMMAND.help: Remove community (or only its source restriction)

PARAM.name: source
PARAM.help: Remove only the source restriction (community accepts any source)

COMMAND.ACTION:
if [ -n "${source}" ]; then
tertoos-cli candidate delete snmp/community/${name}/source
else
tertoos-cli candidate delete snmp/community/${name}
fi

COMMAND.name: snmp-server user
COMMAND.ACTION:
tertoos-cli candidate set snmp/user/${name}
tertoos-cli candidate set snmp/user/${name}/auth ${auth}

COMMAND.name: snmp-server agent-address
COMMAND.help: Listen only on this address (default: all addresses)

PARAM.name: ip
PARAM.help: Agent IPv4/IPv6 address (must exist on this switch, e.g. the loopback)

COMMAND.ACTION: tertoos-cli candidate set snmp/agent-address ${ip} ${port} ${vrf} && { { ip -o addr show | awk '{split($4,p,/\//); print p[1]}'; tertoos-cli candidate show 2>/dev/null | awk '$0 ~ /^set interface\/[^\/]+\/ipv[46]\/address / {split($3,p,/\//); print p[1]}'; } | grep -qixF -- "${ip}" || echo "% Warning: ${ip} is not configured on any interface of this box (nor pending in this candidate). Accepted, but it is not used until the address exists."; }

PARAM.name: ip
PARAM.help: Agent IPv4/IPv6 address (must exist on this switch)
